Home / Spaces

Our Purpose-Built Learning Spaces

Shomoukh nursery school is full of life. Spaces, areas, and corners around the school are designed with intention and purpose to promote happiness, creativity, collaboration, and learning in the best way possible.

REGGIO EMILIA PHILOSOPHY

The Environment: "The Third Teacher"

The classrooms and outdoor areas are spaces that offer provocations for learning, exploration, and play. Spaces are interconnected to support communication, curiosity, and interaction between children and adults.

The environment is rich in opportunities and is modified dynamically based on ongoing projects and learning experiences. Care for spaces and resources is viewed as an essential educational component, and safety is our top priority.

Interconnected

Corridors, piazzas, and ateliers seamlessly link indoor discovery with outdoor nature.

Provocative

Natural materials and tools evoke questions, hypothesis testing, and collaborative work.

PURPOSE-BUILT ENVIRONMENT

14 Purpose-Built Facilities & Spaces

Every corner of Shomoukh is thoughtfully curated to empower each child's physical, creative, intellectual, and social development.

Art and Clay Ateliers

Hands-on research ateliers for tactile exploration, clay shaping, painting, and diverse symbolic expressions.

Digital / Light Atelier

Investigating light, shadows, projectors, optical logic, and creative digital learning strategies.

Drama Room

A dedicated space for puppetry, dramatic roleplay, storytelling, and expressive confidence.

Indoor Gymnasium

Climbers, balance tracks, and soft gym apparatus nurturing physical fitness and motor coordination.

Indoor Playground

Safe, climate-controlled dynamic play zone designed for active movement throughout the entire year.

Library

Rich collection of age-appropriate multilingual books, cozy reading corners, and quiet discovery pods.

Modern Outdoor Playgrounds

Custom-built outdoor equipment, green areas, and sensory trails meeting European safety standards.

Nurse's Clinic

Fully equipped medical clinic staffed by licensed healthcare professionals for daily safety and care.

Open Spaces

Interconnected corridors and wide breakout areas facilitating spontaneous interaction and curiosity.

Organic Garden

Children plant seeds, care for herbs, and discover natural life cycles and environmental sustainability.

Pretend Play Areas – Tiny Towns

Miniature civic community zones for roleplay, shopping, health center, and social problem-solving.

Sand Kitchens

Sensory wet and dry sand workstations where tactile curiosity and collaborative recipes flourish.

Spacious Classrooms With Natural Light

Expansive rooms flooded with sunlight, ergonomic furniture, and flexible layout provocations.

Piazza (Central Square)

A central, open space where students, educators, and families can get together, interact, and collaborate.

SIGNATURE HIGHLIGHTS

Signature Spaces that Inspire Wonder

From the heart of the Italian piazza model to interactive organic gardens, our spaces invite joyful discovery every morning.

The Central Piazza

Modeled after Italian town squares, the Piazza is the beating heart of our school where all classrooms converge. Children, teachers, and parents meet, share dialogue, present work, and celebrate community milestones.

The Organic Garden

A living outdoor science laboratory. Children plant seeds, nurture herbs and vegetables, observe pollinators, and discover the wonder of seasonal growth, embedding sustainability and respect for nature from their earliest years.

Sunlit Classrooms

Expansive windows flood our rooms with natural light. Flexible modular furniture, natural wood finishes, and dynamic provocations invite children to choose how and where they investigate, create, and concentrate.

EXPERIENCE OUR CAMPUSES

Come See Our Spaces in Person

Schedule a personalized tour of our Al Mouj or Al Qurm campuses to experience our ateliers, gyms, and classrooms first-hand.
